201730042.title: File:Chatra in Rama IX Lanna Park 2026 2.jpg

ImageDescription.value: A 9-tiered chatra posted in Rama IX Lanna Park, Chiang Mai, Thailand. In Thailand, a 9-tiered chatra is regalia reserved for crowned Thai kings. It is used here to honor Bhumibol Adulyadej, the ninth king of the Chakri Dynasty of Thailand.

77560463.title: File:Pond of Kuruwapari Chaudharitol- Inaruwa, Kosi Municipality-WLV-2252.jpg

ImageDescription.value: Reflection of Bakain tree (Melia azedarach) near the pond of Kuruwapari Chaudharitol- Inaruwa, Kosi Municipality. Inaruwa इनरुवा is the headquarters of Sunsari District in Nepal. It merged with several VDCs, including Babiya, Jalpapur, and Madhesa. It lies on the Mahendra Highway, and is 25km Northeast away from Koshi Barrage and 18.6km from Koshi Tappu Wildlife Reserve.
